label: Pin-Up & Glamour Heritage
description: The heritage glamour picture: mid-century pin-up, the classic centerfold, burlesque, the studio bombshell portrait. The treatment slot is what makes the frame period-correct, so the same wardrobe and pose read as illustration, printed page or stage depending on the lineage picked. The subject is built from atomic parts rather than human/profile, because that section carries its own wardrobe/glamour draw and a pin-up has to own its wardrobe. Tasteful tier; all subjects adult.
